name: Dutron Polymers Limited
about: Dutron Polymers Limited engages in the manufacturing of plastic pipes in India and internationally. The company offers suction hoses, including duct, heavy duty line for higher abrasion resistance, heavy duty, medium duty (M.D.), nontoxic, and oil hoses; and braided hoses comprising high pressure air hose, welding hose, steel wire hose, spray and car washing hose, as well as garden and construction water hose, spray, CW power, and rock drill hose; and flat hoses. It also provides uPVC pipes and fittings, such as casing, drainage, and submersible column pipes; plumbing, agriculture, and SWR pipes and fittings; and fabricated fittings. In addition, the company offers HDPE fittings, pipes, sprinkler systems, woven sacks, fabrics, bags, and installation services. Further, it provides CPVC pipes and fittings; DWC pipes, electrical, and multipurpose corrugated pipes; and water tanks. Dutron Polymers Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
